We already implemented this logic on the Ubiquity Dollar and pay.ubq.fi repositories, but it seems that it was overlooked within this template. The purpose of this is for reviewers to easily be able to review the work.
Example deployment comment: https://github.com/ubiquity/pay.ubq.fi/pull/148#issuecomment-1916873700
1. Make sure to copy the code so that it works from this template. 
   - I guess it uses https://github.com/ubiquity/.github/blob/main/.github/workflows/deploy.yml
   - and https://github.com/ubiquity/.github/blob/main/utils/print-deployments-logs.js
2. It seems sloppy. Refactor the code to be clean and all in TypeScript (or inside of GitHub Actions whatever makes more sense) and neatly organized inside of the `.github` directory.
4. I can't find the example, but I realized that the commits are actually posting in reverse chronological order. This must be fixed.
